## What

One or two sentences: what changes, and for whom.

## Why

The bug, the gap, or the decision this answers. Link the issue, the QA note, or the design doc in `docs/design/`.

## How to check

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cd desktop && cargo build` passes (if the desktop changed)
- [ ] Manual check, if any: what you ran and what you saw (a screenshot or a recording for UI changes)

## Notes for the reviewer

Trade-offs, follow-ups, anything left open.
